svg.aria-label: The optimization loop drawn as a small proving bench. A carriage carries a card (the text being optimized) along a rail between four stations: a rack of cards (the pool of best versions), a bridge of five probes with a score dial (the evaluator), an engraving head fed by a cable from the probes (the LLM proposer reading the diagnostics), and a height gauge beside a master card (the winner check against the old best).
svg.text: Pick one version of your text from the pool.
Score it on a few examples. One of the five fails.
An LLM reads what failed and rewrites the text.
Score the rewrite. All five examples pass now.
Check it against the old best. It is better, so it is kept.
Back to the pool. Repeat until the budget runs out.
